facts.value: 1610 Remonstrance. Expelled by the Synod of Dordrecht 1618 to 1619

citations.excerpt: and in 1610 presented to the states of Holland and Friesland a “remonstrance” in five articles formulating their points of departure from stricter Calvinism.
The Synod of Dordrecht (1618-19) expelled the Remonstrants (as they were called) and dismissed 200 ministers, many of whom were banished or imprisoned.
These ministers formed themselves into a "brotherhood", a description later taken over by Remon-strant-Reformed congregations.
REMONSTRANTS, the name given to those Dutch Protestants who, after the death of Arminius ( q.v. ), maintained the views associated with his name

facts.value: Held that predestination is conditional, the atonement universal in intention, and grace not irresistible.

citations.excerpt: (1) that the divine decree of predestination is conditional, not absolute; (2) that the Atonement is in intention universal
(4) that though the grace of God is a necessary condition of human effort it does not act irresistibly in man
